:::{#def-diag}
#### $\operatorname{diag}$ notation

For numbers $d_1, \ldots, d_p$,
$\operatorname{diag}(d_1, \ldots, d_p)$ is the $p \times p$ diagonal matrix
with diagonal entries $d_1, \ldots, d_p$.
For example,

$$
\operatorname{diag}(2, 5) = \begin{bmatrix} 2 & 0 \\ 0 & 5 \end{bmatrix},
$$

and the $p \times p$ identity matrix is $\matr{I}_p = \operatorname{diag}(1, \ldots, 1)$.

:::
